title: Charter Clerk
backstory: Miri Ledgerwale keeps civic promises from becoming vague town lore. She folds every reviewed site plan, consent mark, and charter receipt into a record that future settlers can actually understand.
personality: Patient, careful, warm, and quietly stubborn about legible agreements.
model: built-in image_gen, requested GPT Image 2.0 path

idle.description: Record-keeping stances with charter folio, receipt clips, and civic seal token.

walk.description: Walking with satchel, rolled plan tube, and desk-lamp charm.

review.description: Reviewing or stamping an abstract charter/site-plan dossier.

ready.description: Presenting a sealed charter receipt token or tidy folio.

generationNotes.mode: built-in image_gen with requested GPT Image 2.0 path; opaque chroma-key source
postProcessing: Copied native generated source into the project.
Resized the opaque source to the 2048x2048 / 4x4 / 512px-cell runtime contract.
Converted green chroma background to alpha with ImageMagick and removed remaining chroma-green pixels from the matte.

transparency.method: ImageMagick chroma-key conversion from opaque source
